origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 屈 (bend) as the sound: to dig with the hands, excavate.

罩.def: cover, shroud; basket for catching fish

origin.says: 罒 (net) for the meaning plus 卓 (tall) as the sound: a basket trap for fish, then any cover or hood.

罩.name: cover

origin.says: 殿 (hall, from a 'buttocks' character) as the sound plus ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning: the buttocks.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 要 (want), which first meant waist, as the sound: the waist, the lower back.
页 (head) for the meaning plus 元 (first, once "head") as the sound: a hard, unbending head, stubborn. Simplified from 頑 by the cursive head 页.
心 (heart) for the meaning plus 门 (gate) as the sound: a heart shut in, gloomy, stuffy. Simplified from 悶, with 門 written 门.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 皇 (emperor) as the sound: blazing, brilliant.

顷.def: a moment; a unit of area equal to 100 mu

origin.says: Simplified from 頃: 匕 (a person turned over) beside 頁 (head): a head tilted askew, first meaning to lean. It was borrowed for a moment and a unit of land; 頁 became 页.

顷.name: moment

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus a shortened 岸 (shore) as the sound: charcoal. The top 山 (mountain) and 厂 (cliff) are what is left of 岸; the lower part now looks like 灰 (ash).
Simplified from 鑰: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 龠 (a flute) as the sound. The simplified form writes metal as 钅 and replaces the complex 龠 with 月 (moon), a rough sound match: the key.
Simplified from 錫: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 易 (easy) as the sound: the metal tin. The metal radical took its short form 钅.

桶.def: bucket, pail, tub; can, cask, keg

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: a wooden bucket or tub.

桶.name: bucket

挫.def: to check, to obstruct, to push down

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 坐 (sit) as the sound: to push down, to check, hence a setback.

挫.name: setback

吊.def: to condole, to mourn, to pity; to hang

origin.says: A popular form of 弔 (to mourn), which arose between the Han and Tang dynasties. The old 弔 drew a person wound with a corded arrow. The popular form is shaped like 口 (mouth) over 巾 (cloth) and now mostly means to hang.

吊.name: mourn

斩.def: to chop, to cut, to sever; to behead

origin.says: Simplified from 斬: 车 (chariot) plus 斤 (axe). Cutting with an axe, explained as an execution carried out in war (chariots). 車 became 车.

斩.name: behead

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: a slope of earth, a hillside.

扶.def: to support, to protect, to help

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 夫 (man) as the sound: to hold someone up, to support.

扶.name: support

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 喿 (chirping) as the sound: dried out as by fire, arid.

ety.hint: Two hands 廾 breaking something 敝; 敝 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 敝 (tattered, destroy) as sound and meaning plus 廾 (two hands): tearing something apart with both hands, so harm, abuse, fraud.

ety.hint: The stomach ⺼ behind the abdominal muscles 田

origin.says: The top was a drawing of the stomach with grain inside, now shaped like 田 (field); ⺝ (flesh) was added below to mark a body part.

哀.def: sad, mournful, pitiful; to pity; to grieve

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning, set inside 衣 (clothes), which gives the sound: a mouth crying out in grief, sad.

哀.name: lament

蚀.def: to nibble at, to erode; an eclipse

ety.hint: An insect 虫 bite 饣; 饣 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 蝕: 虫 (insect) eating (食, also the sound): insects nibbling away, to erode; an eclipse is the sun being eaten. 食 is written 饣.

蚀.name: erode

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: a mountain high and steep; hence stern.

披.def: to wear; to split, to crack

ety.hint: To put on 扌 fur 皮; 皮 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: to split open, and to throw something over the shoulders.

披.name: drape

刮.def: to shave; to scrape; to blow

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus an old sound part (氏 over 口) that later took the shape of 舌 (tongue): to scrape, shave. It also took over 颳 'wind blowing'.

刮.name: scrape

盯.def: to rivet one's gaze upon; to keep eyes on

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: eyes nailed on something, to stare at it.

盯.name: stare

origin.says: Originally two 東 (bundles) side by side, 'a pair, peers'; a mouth mark was added below. The two bundles merged into one top part and the mark became 日-like: officials, a group.

隧.def: tunnel, underground passage; a path to a tomb

origin.says: 阝 (mound, hill) for the meaning plus 遂 (follow through) as the sound: a passage through earth, a tunnel.

隧.name: tunnel

泼.def: to pour, to splash, to sprinkle, to water

ety.hint: To send forth 发 water 氵

origin.says: From 潑: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 發 (send out) as the sound: to splash water. 發 was shortened to 发.

泼.name: splash

忌.def: jealous, envious; to fear; to shun

origin.says: 己 (self) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a feeling in the heart of dread or jealousy, to shun.

忌.name: shun

蔽.def: to cover, to hide, to shelter

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 敝 (tattered) as the sound: covered by plants, to hide, to shelter.

蔽.name: conceal

叠.def: pile; layer; to fold up; to repeat, to duplicate

ety.hint: Clothes 叒 stacked on top of a drawer 冝

origin.says: From 疊: 畾 (three fields; earlier three suns) over 宜 (fitting): things piled up in layers. The simplified form replaces the three fields with three hands 又 (hand).

叠.name: stack

origin.says: 尸 (body) with 匕 (here a person) under it: one person leaning on another, first meaning close or to stop. Now mostly used for its sound, as in nun and in foreign names.

贺.def: to congratulate; to send a present

ety.hint: To add 加 to someone else's fortune 贝

origin.says: 贝 (cowry money) for the meaning plus 加 (add) as the sound: adding a gift of value, to congratulate. Simplified by writing 貝 (shell) as 贝.

贺.name: congratulate

origin.says: A picture of an umbrella: the canopy on top, the people-like ribs below it and the handle. The simplified form writes the four little people as two dots.

耍.def: to play, to frolic, to amuse

ety.hint: A woman 女 wearing a beard 而 for disguise

origin.says: A late character of 而 (beard) over 女 (woman); the dictionaries agree that what the parts first meant is unknown. It means to play, to tease, to show off a skill.

耍.name: frolic

宰.def: to slaughter, to butcher; to govern, to rule

ety.hint: A barracks 宀 where slaves 辛 live

origin.says: 宀 (house) over a sign for governing, which has worn into the shape of 辛 (bitter): the house of government, a steward; also to slaughter. Mnemonic readings of 辛 as a slave are later.

宰.name: steward

饲.def: to raise animals; to nourish, to feed

origin.says: 饣 (food) for the meaning plus 司 (manage) as the sound: to feed, to raise animals. Simplified from 飼 (飠 to 饣).

饲.name: feed

嘲.def: to deride, to jeer at, to ridicule, to scorn

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 朝 (morning) as the sound: to jeer at someone with the mouth.

嘲.name: jeer

拦.def: to block, to hinder, to obstruct

origin.says: Simplified from 攔: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 闌 (barrier) as the sound, replaced by 兰: to block the way.

拦.name: bar the way

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: first roasting meat wrapped up, later the cannon (also written 砲 with 石, stone).

迄.def: to extend, to reach; till, until

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 乞 (to beg) as the sound: to reach, to arrive at; 'up to, until'.

迄.name: until

灌.def: to water, to irrigate; to pour; to flood

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 雚 (heron) as the sound: to pour water in, to irrigate.

灌.name: irrigate

ety.hint: A dog turned to the side

origin.says: A side view of a dog standing upright on the page: dog.

犬.name: hound
犬.in: 然获器状突献厌狱哭燃默臭伏袱嗅吠莽

肆.def: to indulge; excess; four (bankers' anti-fraud numeral)

ety.hint: Having long 镸 hair 聿

origin.says: 镸 (long hair) for the meaning plus 隶 as the sound; the right part later took the shape 聿 (brush). Meanings: to set out, to let loose, unbridled; also a fraud-proof 'four'.

肆.name: unbridled

ety.hint: Small 小 flakes of earth 土

origin.says: Traditional 塵 is 鹿 (deer) over 土 (earth): the dust raised by running deer. The simplified form, an old variant, puts 小 (small) over 土 (earth): small bits of earth, dust.

ety.hint: A person 人 in a cell 囗

origin.says: A person (人) inside an enclosure (囗): a prisoner, to confine.

ety.hint: A tongue 千 sticking out of a mouth 口

origin.says: A drawing of a tongue (once forked, like a snake's) coming out of 口 (mouth).

舌.name: tongue
舌.in: 活话括适乱敌啥辞舒甜舍阔舔刮恬

ety.hint: An animal with horns 丷, eyes 田, nose 一, and mouth 口

origin.says: From 獸: 單 (hunting weapon) with 犬 (dog), hunting, then the hunted animal. The simplified form drops 犬 and keeps a shortened weapon part.

ety.hint: A person in a robe 衣 with his heart 中 marked; 中 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 衣 (clothing) pulled apart around 中 (middle), which gives the sound and meaning: underclothes worn next to the body, hence one's inner, heartfelt feeling.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 象 (elephant) as the sound: a kind of oak; now also the rubber tree and rubber.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 野 (countryside) as the sound, which also hints at the meaning: a country house, villa.

煽.def: to stir up, to incite; to agitate, to provoke

ety.hint: To fan 扇 the flames 火; 扇 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 扇 (fan) as the sound and sense: to fan the flames, to stir up.

煽.name: fan flames

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 㔷 (a box 匚 around 丙) as the sound, lòu: a narrow, cramped place, hence crude, mean, ugly.

贬.def: to devalue, to demote; to criticize, to censure

ety.hint: To devalue 乏 currency 贝

origin.says: Simplified from 貶: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 乏 (lack) as the sound: to lower the value; hence to demote, to belittle. 貝 is written 贝.

贬.name: devalue

origin.says: 疒 (illness) for the meaning plus 叟 (old man) as the sound: thin and lean, as from sickness.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 婴 (baby) as the sound: the cherry tree. Simplified from 櫻 by the short 贝 (shell).

踏.def: to trample, to tread on, to walk over

origin.says: 足 (foot, written 𧾷) for the meaning plus 沓 (repeated, piled) as the sound: to tread, to step on.

踏.name: stomp

origin.says: Simplified from 僑: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as the sound: a person living away from home, an emigrant.

捍.def: to defend, to guard; to ward off

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 旱 (drought) as the sound: to ward off, to defend.

捍.name: ward off

赁.def: to rent, to lease; to hire; employee

ety.hint: Someone 任 working for money 贝

origin.says: 任 (duty, employment) as the sound plus 贝 (shell, money): money paid for hire or rent. Simplified from 賃 only by writing 貝 (shell) as 贝.

赁.name: lease

掀.def: to stir up; to turn over

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 欣 (glad) as the sound: lifting something with the hand, to lift up or turn over.

掀.name: lift lid

ety.hint: Expensive 贵 food 饣; 贵 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 饋: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 貴 (precious) as the sound: to offer food, a gift. 食 is written 饣 and 貴 贵.

腾.def: to fly, to soar; to gallop, to prance; rising, steaming

origin.says: 朕 (I, the emperor) as the sound plus 马 (horse) for the meaning: a horse galloping and leaping, then to soar and rise. Simplified from 騰 by writing 馬 as 马.

腾.name: soar

悟.def: to apprehend, to realize, to become aware

origin.says: ⺖ (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 吾 (I) as the sound: to realize, to awaken to.

悟.name: realize

origin.says: Simplified from 墳: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 賁 (ornate) as the sound, replaced by 文 (writing) as a simpler sound part: a burial mound, a grave.
纟 (thread, rope) for the meaning plus 冈 (ridge) as the sound: the head rope of a net that pulls it all, hence outline, guiding principle. Simplified from 綱.

斥.def: to scold, to upbraid; to accuse, to blame; to reproach

ety.hint: Someone scolded for cutting themselves 丶 with an axe 斤

origin.says: First written 㡿: 广 (building) plus 屰 (upside-down person, 'against') as the sound. Over time the parts were squeezed and rewritten until the build is no longer visible. The sense 'to repel, to scold' comes from 'against'.

斥.name: rebuke

逆.def: to disobey, to rebel; traitor, rebel

ety.hint: A disobedient 屰 person 辶; 屰 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 屰 (an upside-down person), also the sound, plus 辶 (walk): going the opposite way, against, rebellious.

逆.name: against

拓.def: to develop, to expand, to open up

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 石 (stone) as the sound: to push open with the hands, to open up, to expand; also to take rubbings.

拓.name: open up

origin.says: 壴 (drum) for the meaning plus 加 (add) as the sound: drum music of celebration, 'excellent, joyful'.
Simplified from 檻: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 監 (supervise) as the sound: a wooden pen or fence, also a door threshold. It uses the simplified 监.

虫 (insect) for the meaning plus a sound part: wax, made by bees and lac insects, and candles. The full form 蠟 had 巤 as the sound; simplified 蜡 took over an existing character with 昔 (former times) as the sound.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 曹 (officials) as the sound: a wooden trough or vat.
